headline: Broad Street retaining wall, Greenlawn Chapel Restoration, and West Chapel Slope projects, plus cemetery pond plans.
summary: The main items are trespassing concerns and a retaining wall project at Broad Street Cemetery, and the Chapel Restoration Project at Greenlawn Cemetery. Other items include a post-Halloween security report and a review of the policy on lowering caskets during burials.
items: Superintendent Kieran Kavanaugh's report on daily cemetery operations
Broad Street Cemetery: trespassing concerns, retaining wall project, Elijah Sanderson marker
Greenlawn Cemetery: Chapel Restoration Project and ribbon cutting ceremony
West Chapel Slope: project status report and ADA update
Post-Halloween cemetery security report, including observed damage, reported trespassing, and Charter Street general opportunity
Policy on lowering caskets during internments, with findings to be reported by Kieran
Cemetery ponds: 2026 algae issues, 2027 algae plans, floating garden funding, maintenance, and planned projects
location: Levesque Community Life Center Great Room, 401 Bridge Street, Salem, MA
